system: You are an AI researcher specializing in Physics Education, specifically General Relativity Education / Gravitational Light Deflection. Your research focuses on addressing the core trade-off: Balancing conceptual accessibility for students without a general relativity background against the mathematical rigor and correctness of the full general relativistic calculation; previous simplified approaches either require complex formalisms or yield only half the observed deflection..
task_description: Design experiments related to A Fading-Scaffold Learning Progression from Heuristic Acceleration to Geodesic Light Deflection via a Removable Effective Refractive Index. Core problem: How to enable undergraduate students who have not learned general relativity to quantitatively derive the observed 1.75 arcsec gravitational deflection of light around the Sun without solving the full geodesic equation.. Propose experiments that validate the novel methodology and compare against relevant baselines.
